Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: The user's reusable bio, target profiles, experience, and educational background used to calibrate the scoring model.

fullName.description: Full legal or professional name of the candidate.

education.description: Latest degree description (e.g., S1 Management, Universitas Negeri Malang).

graduationDate.description: Date or period when graduated (e.g., Jun 2025).

workExperienceCount.description: Years of experience or count of key experiences.

experienceBrief.description: Detailed multi-paragraph context of experiences and achievements (e.g., Material Control, site tracking, coordinating, XL Axiata analyst internship).

targetRoles.description: Target job families (e.g., Business Operations, Management Trainee, Analyst, Technology Consulting).

preferredLocations.description: Preferred areas or workspace types (e.g., Jakarta, hybrid, remote).

portfolioWording.description: Default text or technical highlights describing personal portfolio products, such as the AI Workflow Automation OS.

CVEvidence.title: CVEvidence
CVEvidence.description: A verified item or bank entry of historical experience that acts as ground-truth evidence.

category.description: Category of evidence (e.g., Work Experience, Internship, Project).

title.description: The title or role associated with the evidence.

organization.description: The company, organization, or personal brand.

description.description: Full descriptions of the quantitative achievements, tools, and workflows.

isVerified.description: Whether the user has verified this action item is accurate.

JobSearchRaw.title: JobSearchRaw
JobSearchRaw.description: Staging area for incoming raw, uncrawled, or pasted job postings.

sourceUrl.description: The URL source of the posting.

jobText.description: Raw unparsed text representation of the job.

searchQuery.description: Search keyword or trigger used to fetch it.

dedupeKey.description: Unique key to prevent repeated parsing.

CareerRadarOpportunity.title: CareerRadarOpportunity
CareerRadarOpportunity.description: Successful structured opportunities parsed, classified, and scored by the radar.

roleDna.description: Extracted style/DNA (e.g., MT, Data Analyst, Operations, Tech Consulting).

isStretchRole.description: If the role requires 2+ years of experience but is processed with cautious scoring.

ApplicationPack.title: ApplicationPack
ApplicationPack.description: Tailored application content and optimized copywriting matching a specific job.

applicationEnergy.description: High / Medium / Lock rating representing priority focus.

cvAction.description: Suggested approach (e.g. Angle Shift, Minor Edits, Standard Template).

cvAngle.description: Primary communication framing (e.g. Highlight Tech & Systems).

keywordsToEmphasize.description: Sanitized hard skills to bubble up.

bulletPrioritization.description: Grounded list of project or job bullets to rearrange or emphasize.

portfolioEvidence.description: How the AI Workflow Automation OS or site coordinating tracks align.

CVEditChecklist.title: CVEditChecklist
CVEditChecklist.description: Atomic edit tasks derived from analysis, providing copy-quality evidence-grounded suggestions.

cvSection.description: CV Section identifier (e.g. Summary, Experience, Project, Skill).

sourceEvidence.description: Factual reference to experience from the database.

finalSuggestedText.description: Sanitized candidate-facing suggerations ready to copy.

evidenceId.description: Grounding verification reference linking this edit back to the CV_Evidence_Bank.

isStale.description: Flags older checklist entries of the same company that were superseded.

DailyApplyBrief.title: DailyApplyBrief
DailyApplyBrief.description: Lightweight action queue and status memory tracker summarizing target listings.

userActionNeeded.description: Custom actions like review and update grounding.

/profiles/{userId}.description: The user's direct profile context and core metadata.

/profiles/{userId}/cv_evidences/{evidenc.description: User's evidence bank of verified facts for CV items.

/profiles/{userId}/job_search_raw/{rawId.description: Staging logs for jobs crawled, parsed, or copied to prepare for radar.

/profiles/{userId}/opportunities/{radarI.description: Analyzed job openings with scores, evaluations, and decision parameters.

/profiles/{userId}/application_packs/{pa.description: Grounded cover briefs, angle updates, summaries, and copy suggestions per analyzed opportunity.

/profiles/{userId}/cv_checklists/{checkl.description: Actionable improvements and atomic edit suggestions with grounding checks.

/profiles/{userId}/daily_apply_briefs/{b.description: Daily application tasks and status history trackers.
